instruction: Create a simple 4.50 m by 12.87 m living room with a 2.797 m ceiling. Put a gray wooden storage locker near the north wall and a dark gray round coffee table near it. Place a black leather sofa in the south part of the room. Put one gray textured potted plant at the southwest corner and a second potted plant near the east wall and near the sofa. Place a gray open shelving wardrobe in the east part of the room.
